name: SS-31 (Elamipretide)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: SS-31 (Elamipretide) (2S) is a structurally modified synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 5 mg, 10 mg, 50 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is SS-31 (Elamipretide) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each 2S lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 736992-21-5, formula C32H49N9O5, 639.8 Da).

faq.question: How should SS-31 (Elamipretide) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for SS-31 (Elamipretide): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the 2S lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for SS-31 (Elamipretide)?
faq.answer: SS-31 (Elamipretide) is stocked in 3 pack sizes (5 mg, 10 mg, 50 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $47.64; 10–49 kits falls to $43.82 (−8%) and 50+ to $40.50 (−15%).
